base.rule: 2%-98% temporal channel range > 12 or exact range > 16; 9px closing, large-component fill, 11px closing, 1px dilation, >=16px scanline runs, then 2x2 command alignment
base.mode: RGBA; transparent pixels are excluded from the immutable WebGL base

referenceDriven.position: residual centroid within each stroke search region
referenceDriven.shape: reference covariance drives radii and rotation
referenceDriven.color: reference-frame mean color in residual region
referenceDriven.detail: offline frames are serialized as 2x2 RGB555 primitive commands and sparse per-pixel repaints; runtime stroke geometry is corrected against the decoded dynamic canvas

frameCommands.format: SBT4 zlib/deflate; coherent RGBA static base, RGB555 2x2 keyframe drawing commands and sparse absolute-position per-pixel drawing deltas
frameCommands.deltaCommand: LEB128 absolute pixel gap plus 2-byte RGB555 color
